milestones.title: GDG Chapter Founded
milestones.subtitle: The Beginning
milestones.description: GDG on Campus DGI was officially established with 15 founding members passionate about technology and community building.

milestones.title: First Tech Talk
milestones.subtitle: Introduction to Cloud Computing
milestones.description: Our inaugural event attracted 50+ students and featured a hands-on workshop on Google Cloud Platform fundamentals.

milestones.title: Android Study Jam
milestones.subtitle: Mobile Development
milestones.description: Successfully completed a 4-week Android development program with 30 participants earning certifications.

milestones.title: DevFest 2023
milestones.subtitle: Our Biggest Event
milestones.description: Hosted our first DevFest with 200+ attendees, 8 speakers, and workshops covering AI, Web, and Mobile development.

milestones.title: Solution Challenge
milestones.subtitle: Global Competition
milestones.description: Three teams from our chapter qualified for the Google Solution Challenge, with one team reaching the top 100 globally.

milestones.title: Community Milestone
milestones.subtitle: 500+ Members
milestones.description: Reached 500 active community members and became one of the most active GDG chapters in the region.

milestones.title: AI/ML Bootcamp
milestones.subtitle: Machine Learning
milestones.description: Intensive 2-week bootcamp on AI and Machine Learning with TensorFlow, attended by 80+ students.

milestones.title: Looking Ahead
milestones.subtitle: Future Plans
milestones.description: Expanding our programs with more workshops, hackathons, and partnerships with industry leaders.
